definitions.explanation: An administrative subdivision of a prefecture, typically rural areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧{郡|ぐん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{属|ぞく}している→属する：12402_zokusuru⟧。
examples.english: This village belongs to Nishi District.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郡|ぐん}{部|ぶ}→郡部：24863_gunbu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〇〇⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧〇〇{郡|ぐん}〇〇⟦{町|ちょう}→町：00613_machi⟧です。

notes:
JAPANESE ADMINISTRATIVE DIVISIONS:
{郡|ぐん} is a subdivision of a prefecture (⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧) that contains towns (⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧) and villages (⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧). Cities (⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧) are not part of any {郡|ぐん}.

Hierarchy: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧ → ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ → {郡|ぐん} → {町|ちょう}/{村|そん}

COMMON TERMS:
- ⟦{郡|ぐん}{部|ぶ}→郡部：24863_gunbu⟧ (rural areas; non-city areas)
- {郡|ぐん}{内|ない} (within the district)
- 〇〇{郡|ぐん} (X District)

USAGE:
In addresses, {郡|ぐん} appears between the prefecture and town/village name. This indicates the location is rural (not a city).

Not to be confused with:
- ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (army; military)
